items.attribution: Louisa May Alcott · Little Women · Project Gutenberg
items.title: Jo's Nervous Meeting in Little Women

sentences.en: This passage is adapted from Little Women, a well-known novel about the four March sisters and their lives.
sentences.zh: 这段文字改编自《小妇人》，一部关于马奇家四姐妹及其生活的著名小说。

sentences.en: The main character here is Jo March, the second sister and an independent young woman who loves writing.
sentences.zh: 这里的主要人物是乔·马奇，她是二姐，一位热爱写作的独立年轻女性。

sentences.en: Jo has arranged to meet her close friend Laurie, a young man she affectionately calls Teddy.
sentences.zh: 乔已安排去见她的密友劳里，一个她亲切地称作“泰迪”的年轻人。

sentences.en: Recently, she has been worried that Laurie might want to propose marriage to her.
sentences.zh: 最近，她一直担心劳里可能想向她求婚。

sentences.en: She thinks she has already given him every reason to know what her answer will be.
sentences.zh: 她认为自己已经给了他充分的理由，让他知道她的回答会是什么。

sentences.en: After an evening of quiet reflection and a morning of work, her fears begin to calm down.
sentences.zh: 经过一个安静沉思的夜晚和一个工作的早晨，她的恐惧开始平静下来。

sentences.en: She decides that it would be vain to assume that everyone is going to propose to her.
sentences.zh: 她决定，如果假定每个人都会向她求婚，那就太自负了。

sentences.en: At the appointed time, she sets out, hoping that Teddy will not do anything that forces her to hurt his feelings.
sentences.zh: 在约定的时间，她出发了，希望泰迪不要做出任何迫使她伤害他感情的事。

sentences.en: On the way, she calls at her sister Meg's house, and the visit gives her some comfort.
sentences.zh: 路上，她顺路去姐姐梅格家拜访，这次探访给了她一些安慰。

sentences.en: Feeling a little stronger, she continues toward the place where she is supposed to meet Laurie.
sentences.zh: 感到稍微坚强了一些，她继续前往她应该与劳里见面的地方。

sentences.en: However, when she sees a tall, strong figure waiting in the distance, her courage suddenly disappears.
sentences.zh: 然而，当她看到远处有一个高大强壮的人影在等待时，她的勇气突然消失了。

sentences.en: At that moment, she has a strong desire to turn around and run all the way home.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，她强烈地想转身一路跑回家。

items.title: A Doctor's Request for Lucy's Letters
items.titleZh: 医生请求阅读露西的信件

sentences.en: In this scene from Bram Stoker's Dracula, a doctor speaks to a grieving man about a young woman named Lucy.
sentences.zh: 在布拉姆·斯托克《德古拉》的这个场景中，一位医生与一位悲伤的男子谈起一位名叫露西的年轻女子。

sentences.en: Lucy has died, and her personal letters and papers are now in the man's care.
sentences.zh: 露西已经去世，她个人的信件和文件现在由这名男子保管。

sentences.en: Her friends are still shocked by her death, and they want to protect her memory.
sentences.zh: 她的朋友们仍为她的去世感到震惊，他们想维护对她的回忆。

sentences.en: The doctor asks the man for permission to read all of Lucy's letters and papers.
sentences.zh: 医生请求男子允许他阅读露西所有的信件和文件。

sentences.en: He explains that he is not acting out of simple or idle curiosity.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，自己并非出于单纯或无聊的好奇心。

sentences.en: Instead, he has a serious motive, and he believes Lucy would have approved of it.
sentences.zh: 相反，他有一个严肃的动机，而且他相信露西会认可这个动机。

sentences.en: The doctor already has the letters, but he took them before he learned that they belonged to the man.
sentences.zh: 医生已经拿到了这些信件，但他是在得知它们属于这名男子之前拿走的。

sentences.en: He did this carefully so that no stranger could touch them or look into Lucy's private thoughts.
sentences.zh: 他这样做很谨慎，是为了不让陌生人碰它们，也不让陌生人窥探露西的私人想法。

sentences.en: He promises to keep every page safe and to make sure that no word is lost.
sentences.zh: 他承诺会妥善保管每一页，并确保一个字都不会丢失。

sentences.en: At the moment, he does not want even the man to see them, but he will return them later.
sentences.zh: 目前，他甚至不想让这名男子看到它们，但以后会把它们归还。

sentences.en: He admits that he is asking for something difficult, but he hopes the man will agree for Lucy's sake.
sentences.zh: 他承认自己的请求很为难，但他希望男子能为了露西而同意。

sentences.en: The passage ends before we hear the man's answer, leaving the reader with a tense and emotional request.
sentences.zh: 这段文字在听到男子回答之前就结束了，给读者留下了一个紧张而充满情感的请求。

glossary.zh: 为了露西；看在露西的份上

items.attribution: H. G. Wells · The Time Machine · Project Gutenberg
items.title: The Time Traveller's Warning: When Humanity Conquers Nature
items.titleZh: 时间旅行者的警示：当人类征服自然

sentences.en: In H. G. Wells's famous novel The Time Machine, a scientist called the Time Traveller travels far into the future.
sentences.zh: 在H. G. 威尔斯的著名小说《时间机器》中，一位被称为“时间旅行者”的科学家远行到未来。

sentences.en: He arrives in a strange world and meets a small, gentle people who seem weak in body and mind.
sentences.zh: 他来到一个陌生的世界，遇到一群身材矮小、性情温和的人，他们看上去身心都很虚弱。

sentences.en: These people live among enormous ruins, which clearly show that a great and powerful civilization once existed there.
sentences.zh: 这些人生活在巨大的废墟之间，这些废墟清楚地表明那里曾经存在过一个伟大而强盛的文明。

sentences.en: At first, the Traveller believes that humanity has completely conquered nature and finally solved its oldest problems.
sentences.zh: 起初，旅行者相信人类已经完全征服了自然，并最终解决了最古老的问题。

sentences.en: He thinks that after a long battle with nature, people have at last found peace and safety.
sentences.zh: 他认为，人类在与自然长期斗争之后，终于获得了安宁与安全。

sentences.en: He remembers that earlier humans were strong, energetic, and highly intelligent, and they had great vitality.
sentences.zh: 他想起早期人类强壮、精力充沛、非常聪明，并且拥有强大的生命力。

sentences.en: They used that abundant vitality to change the conditions under which they lived and worked.
sentences.zh: 他们用那种充沛的生命力改变了自己生活和工作的条件。

sentences.en: However, those changed conditions begin to act back on human beings in surprising and unexpected ways.
sentences.zh: 然而，那些被改变的条件开始以令人惊讶和意想不到的方式反作用于人类。

sentences.en: Without danger, hunger, or hard work, the future people slowly lose their physical strength and courage.
sentences.zh: 没有危险、饥饿或艰苦劳动，未来的人们慢慢失去了体力和勇气。

sentences.en: Their easy life also weakens their intelligence, reduces their curiosity, and makes them much less creative.
sentences.zh: 他们安逸的生活也削弱了智力，减少了好奇心，并使他们远不如以前有创造力。

sentences.en: When the Traveller understands this result, he feels surprised and deeply worried about the human future.
sentences.zh: 当旅行者明白这一结果时，他感到惊讶，并对人类的未来深感担忧。

sentences.en: The story warns that progress may carry hidden costs for civilization, and it asks what makes human life strong and meaningful.
sentences.zh: 这个故事警示我们，进步可能给文明带来隐性代价，也追问是什么让人类生活坚强而有意义。

glossary.zh: 反过来作用于；对……产生反作用

items.attribution: Lewis Carroll · Alice's Adventures in Wonderland · Project Gutenberg
items.title: A Giant Puppy in Wonderland

sentences.en: In this scene from Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, Alice has become very small and is exploring a strange, unfamiliar world.
sentences.zh: 在这个《爱丽丝梦游仙境》的片段中，爱丽丝变得非常小，正在探索一个奇怪而陌生的世界。

sentences.en: Suddenly, an enormous puppy appears above her and looks down at her with large, round eyes.
sentences.zh: 突然，一只巨大的小狗出现在她上方，用又大又圆的眼睛低头看着她。

sentences.en: The puppy seems curious rather than angry, and it slowly stretches out one paw toward her.
sentences.zh: 小狗看起来好奇而不是生气，它慢慢朝她伸出一只爪子。

sentences.en: It tries to touch Alice gently, as if it wants to find out what this tiny person is.
sentences.zh: 它轻轻地试图碰爱丽丝，好像想弄清楚这个极小的人是什么。

sentences.en: Alice is surprised by the animal's great size, but she also feels a little sorry for it.
sentences.zh: 爱丽丝对这动物巨大的体型感到惊讶，但也为它感到有点难过。

sentences.en: She speaks to the puppy in a gentle, coaxing voice and calls it a poor little thing.
sentences.zh: 她用温柔哄劝的声音对小狗说话，称它“可怜的小东西”。

sentences.en: She tries hard to whistle to it, hoping that friendly sounds will keep the animal calm.
sentences.zh: 她努力对小狗吹口哨，希望友好的声音能让这只动物保持平静。

sentences.en: However, Alice is terribly frightened during the whole meeting, although she tries not to show it.
sentences.zh: 然而，在整个相遇过程中，爱丽丝非常害怕，尽管她尽量不表现出来。

sentences.en: She cannot stop thinking that the puppy might be very hungry after all, and that worries her.
sentences.zh: 她忍不住想，这只小狗毕竟可能很饿，这让她很担心。

sentences.en: If it were hungry, it could easily eat her up, even if she coaxed it politely.
sentences.zh: 如果它饿了，即使她礼貌地哄它，它也可能轻易把她吃掉。

sentences.en: So Alice stays watchful, keeps a safe distance, and does not trust the puppy completely.
sentences.zh: 所以爱丽丝保持警惕，保持安全距离，并不完全信任小狗。

sentences.en: This strange meeting shows how exciting but also how dangerous Wonderland can feel to a tiny girl.
sentences.zh: 这次奇怪的相遇表明，对一个极小的女孩来说，仙境可能多么令人兴奋，又多么危险。

items.attribution: Arthur Conan Doyle · The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes · Project Gutenberg
items.title: A Dangerous Inheritance

sentences.en: Sherlock Holmes, the famous detective in London, once met a young man who had a very unusual problem.
sentences.zh: 伦敦著名侦探夏洛克·福尔摩斯曾接待过一个有着非常不寻常难题的年轻人。

sentences.en: The young man had inherited an old family house from his uncle, but the inheritance had come in a sinister and mysterious way.
sentences.zh: 这个年轻人从叔叔那里继承了一栋老家宅，但这份遗产是以一种不祥而神秘的方式得来的。

sentences.en: His uncle had died under strange circumstances, and the house, along with some money, passed to him.
sentences.zh: 他的叔叔在奇怪的情况下去世，房子和一些钱便传给了他。

sentences.en: Soon after he moved into the old house, frightening events began to disturb his quiet daily life.
sentences.zh: 他搬进那栋老房子后不久，可怕的事情开始扰乱他平静的日常生活。

sentences.en: Friends and relatives often asked him why he did not simply sell the property and move away.
sentences.zh: 亲友们常问他，为什么不干脆卖掉这处房产搬走。

sentences.en: He answered that he was sure the troubles were connected to a serious incident in his uncle’s life.
sentences.zh: 他回答说，他确信这些麻烦与叔叔生活中一件严重的事件有关。

sentences.en: That incident had happened many years before, and its full story had never been made clear to anyone.
sentences.zh: 那件事发生在许多年前，其完整经过从未向任何人说明白。

sentences.en: He believed the danger belonged to his family, not just to that one old building.
sentences.zh: 他认为危险属于他的家族，而不只是属于那一栋老建筑。

sentences.en: Therefore, moving to another home would not keep him safe from the same threat.
sentences.zh: 因此，搬到另一个家并不能让他免受同样的威胁。

sentences.en: Holmes listened carefully to every detail and then began to study the uncle’s troubled past.
sentences.zh: 福尔摩斯仔细听完每个细节，然后开始研究叔叔那段充满麻烦的过去。

sentences.en: He examined old letters, family records, and the movements of people who had been close to the uncle.
sentences.zh: 他检查了旧信件、家族记录，以及那些曾与叔叔关系密切的人的行动。

sentences.en: Finally, Holmes found the truth, explained the strange events, and removed the danger from the young man’s life.
sentences.zh: 最后，福尔摩斯找到了真相，解释了那些怪事，并消除了年轻人生活中的危险。

items.attribution: Robert Louis Stevenson · Treasure Island · Project Gutenberg
items.title: A Secret Listen on the Ship

sentences.en: Jim Hawkins was a young boy sailing on a ship with a group of rough and mysterious sailors.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·霍金斯是个小男孩，正和一群体格粗野、神秘莫测的水手一起乘船航行。

sentences.en: Late one night, he began to worry that some members of the crew were secretly planning something dangerous.
sentences.zh: 一天深夜，他开始担心船员中的一些人正在秘密策划危险的事情。

sentences.en: He decided to move quietly through the dark ship and listen to what they were saying.
sentences.zh: 他决定悄悄穿过黑暗的船，去听他们在说什么。

sentences.en: First, he went down the main stairs and deliberately made as much noise as he could.
sentences.zh: 首先，他走下主楼梯，故意弄出尽可能大的声响。

sentences.en: This clever trick would make the men believe that he had gone below to his bed.
sentences.zh: 这个巧妙的计策会让那些人以为他已经下到船舱床上去了。

sentences.en: After that, he slipped off his shoes so that his footsteps would be almost silent on the wood.
sentences.zh: 之后，他悄悄脱下鞋子，这样他的脚步声踩在木板上几乎不会发出声音。

sentences.en: He ran quietly along a narrow wooden passage and climbed a ladder near the front of the ship.
sentences.zh: 他安静地沿着狭窄的木通道跑，并爬上船头附近的一架梯子。

sentences.en: Very carefully, he raised his head out of a small opening and looked around the deck.
sentences.zh: 他非常小心地把头从一个小开口伸出来，环顾甲板。

sentences.en: He was sure the men would not expect to see him in that hidden unexpected position.
sentences.zh: 他确信那些人不会想到会在那个隐蔽而出乎意料的位置看到他。

sentences.en: Even so, he took every possible precaution and moved only when it seemed completely safe.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，他还是采取了所有可能的预防措施，只在看起来完全安全时才移动。

sentences.en: Soon he heard enough of their talk to realize that his worst fears were true.
sentences.zh: 很快，他听到的谈话足以让他意识到，自己最担心的事是真的。

sentences.en: The sailors were not loyal, and Jim understood that he would have to act with great care from then on.
sentences.zh: 那些水手并不忠诚，吉姆明白从那时起他必须非常小心地行事。
